CASE "phase" WHEN 'preparing' THEN 'In preparation' WHEN 'coming' THEN 'Being prepared by the desk' WHEN 'announced' THEN 'Overview live · room opens soon' WHEN 'open' THEN 'Room open to approved investors' WHEN 'closed' THEN 'Round closed · updates continue for holders' END

credit_direct_deal_lenders_who.name: credit_direct_deal_lenders_who
credit_direct_deal_lenders_who.value: "credit_direct_deal_lenders"."lender_id" is not null or "credit_direct_deal_lenders"."lender_name" is not null

intake_submissions_source.name: intake_submissions_source
intake_submissions_source.value: ("credit_intake_submissions"."source" = 'partner' and "credit_intake_submissions"."partner_id" is not null) or ("credit_intake_submissions"."source" = 'public' and "credit_intake_submissions"."partner_id" is null and "credit_intake_submissions"."access_token_hash" is not null and "credit_intake_submissions"."submitter_role" in ('company', 'agent'))

credit_lender_ticket_order.name: credit_lender_ticket_order
credit_lender_ticket_order.value: "credit_lenders"."min_ticket" is null or "credit_lenders"."max_ticket" is null or "credit_lenders"."min_ticket" <= "credit_lenders"."max_ticket"

credit_lender_rate_order.name: credit_lender_rate_order
credit_lender_rate_order.value: "credit_lenders"."min_rate" is null or "credit_lenders"."max_rate" is null or "credit_lenders"."min_rate" <= "credit_lenders"."max_rate"

credit_prospects_size_positive.name: credit_prospects_size_positive
credit_prospects_size_positive.value: ("credit_prospects"."loan_book_cr" is null or "credit_prospects"."loan_book_cr" >= 0) and ("credit_prospects"."aum_cr" is null or "credit_prospects"."aum_cr" >= 0)

user_role_org.name: user_role_org
user_role_org.value:
("credit_users"."role"::text = 'platform_admin' and "credit_users"."lender_id" is null and "credit_users"."partner_id" is null)
        or ("credit_users"."role"::text = 'partner' and "credit_users"."partner_id" is not null and "credit_users"."lender_id" is null)
        or ("credit_users"."role"::text = 'applicant' and "credit_users"."partner_id" is null and "credit_users"."lender_id" is null)
        or ("credit_users"."role"::text in ('lender_admin', 'lender_viewer') and "credit_users"."lender_id" is not null and "credit_users"."partner_id" is null)
